acceptanceCriteria: A test establishes whether an IMPORT record can carry requiresPool/requiredRoles; if it cannot, the ticket closes with that evidence.
If it can, a re-import with a changed block keeps both keys byte-identical and does not bump acceptanceRevision for them, with a test in internal/tasks/importer or internal/tasks/store.
body: Context: Go 1.27.1, Darwin arm64, 2026-10-04, found while adding issue 502 escalation-reference preservation to importer.record (branch claude/502-escalations-record-key from origin/main cd70ba0a). importer.record builds the next IMPORT revision from importer.TicketKeys only; requiresPool and requiredRoles are not in TicketKeys, so if an IMPORT record carries either (set by REFINE), a re-import with a changed block writes the next revision without them. Both keys are in ticket.AcceptanceRelevantFields, so chain() also bumps acceptanceRevision on that silent removal. This is suspected from reading the code; no reproduction test exists yet. Whether REFINE on a shadow IMPORT record can set these keys at all needs confirming first. Expected: re-import keeps tool-local optional keys the export cannot carry (as it now keeps escalations and createdAt), or refuses. Actual (suspected): keys dropped and acceptance revision bumped.

title: Re-import drops a locally set requiresPool/requiredRoles from an IMPORT record and bumps its acceptance revision
